name: Snare roll
why: A snare that doubles in speed every two bars while getting louder and thinner. It is the countdown to the drop.

ingredients.name: A snare on every beat
ingredients.adds: Four snares to the bar from the default kit.

ingredients.name: Double every two bars
ingredients.adds: Quarter notes, then eighths, sixteenths, and finally thirty-seconds.
ingredients.listenFor: Eight bars that feel like they are accelerating.

ingredients.name: Get louder
ingredients.adds: Starts quiet and ends at full level.

ingredients.name: Thin it as it rises
ingredients.adds: The body of the snare is filtered away over the 8 bars.
ingredients.listenFor: It seems to lift off the ground.

knobs.label: sweep top
knobs.below: The fast part is a low rumble.
knobs.above: Only a tick is left by the end.
